context_requirements: Functional GABA-A receptor expression; most of the nine lines are not neuronal and express little or no GABA-A receptor subunits.
For TSPO-mediated effects, high TSPO expression and a ligand that engages TSPO at 10 micromolar; TSPO activation alone is not expected to produce a robust transcriptional signature in these lines.

For CHRNA7 or P2RX7 effects, expression of the respective receptor and coupling to transcriptional pathways; these are not canonical benzodiazepine receptor targets and are unlikely to be engaged at 10 micromolar in these lines.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional response at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines that is shared across multiple benzodiazepine receptor agonists and absent for inactive enantiomers or antagonists.
Upregulation of canonical GABA-A receptor subunit genes or GABAergic neuronal markers in a non-neuronal line.
A strong, coordinated induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) or stress genes (HSPA1A, DNAJB1) at 6 h that is specific to this class.
Consistent changes in proliferation or cell-cycle landmark genes at 24 h that are not explained by general cytotoxicity.
